notes:
# Handouts it used to miss {doc}
Some classes name their window after the session, and the app was not
looking for handouts in those at all. It looks now.

# Files Zoom had already downloaded {folder}
A handout you downloaded yourself can never be fetched again from Zoom's
panel. The app finds your copy and files it with the recording — including
for recordings you have already made.

# The recording notice sends from a popped-out chat {notes}
It was typed into the box and left there when the chat was in its own
window.

---

Everything else in this release:

- Handouts are listed in the order the host gave them out, not the order
  they were collected.
- A recording being joined into one file says "Saving" instead of showing
  a red "Recording" with the clock still running.
- The app says when the disk is tight, before a recording rather than in
  Settings, and will not start joining a recording without room for it.
- Asking a recording a question now reads the transcript as well as the
  notes, so questions the words answer no longer offer to re-read the
  video.
- See analysis is one window: the recording and its transcript beside the
  conversation, with the moments an answer rests on, questions worth
  asking, a model picker, and a stop button.
- Questions asked while one is being answered are queued instead of
  dropped.
- A long transcript opens at once rather than taking a minute.
